These binary Word fixtures come from the MIT-licensed `word-extractor` upstream
test suite at commit `d971d9f69056245ae129bd2ce31436d518293854`:

https://github.com/morungos/node-word-extractor/tree/d971d9f69056245ae129bd2ce31436d518293854/__tests__/data

- `test01.doc`: insertion/deletion and Unicode text.

- `test11.doc`: Asian language text.
- `test15.doc`: distinct headers and footers.

These are public parser fixtures, not application uploads or user documents.
